races.notes: Best half marathon since returning to training (recent_bests, not all-time PB). Baseline anchoring subsequent HM block training and race projections. Exact date within February 2026 not yet confirmed.

End of 22-week Norwegian Singles HM block, targeting sub-1:55. Opening km averaged ~5:56/km vs ~5:41/km needed for sub-2:00; post-race analysis found zero anaerobic load against a 217-652 target. Gap attributed to motivational/psychological factors (early demoralization from pace data) rather than physiological breakdown.
B-race within the 10K training block (sub-55:00 initial goal, sub-52:00 target, sub-50:00 stretch).

personal_bests._notes: All-time PBs, per device Personal Records. Most predate a multi-year training gap before the 2026 comeback -- see recent_bests for current-era numbers used in near-term pacing/goal decisions.

recent_bests._notes: Best results since the 2026 training comeback -- these are what actually inform current pacing and goal-setting, not the older all-time PBs above.
